Equipped with Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.1, it ensures fast wireless connectivity and compatibility with a wide range of peripherals. Running on Chrome OS—a computer built for the modern world’s workflow—it offers thousands of apps, built-in cloud backups, and Google Assistant, delivering security, speed, up-to-date functionality, versatility, and simplicity, making it ideal for online courses, online school (for K12, K9, and college students), Zoom meetings, and video streaming.

samsung - galaxy chromebook go 14\" hd l.name: Samsung - Galaxy Chromebook Go 14" HD LED Laptop - Intel Celeron N4500 - 4GB RAM - 64GB eMMC+256GB SD Card - Silver
samsung - galaxy chromebook go 14\" hd l.description: Tough yet smart, the Samsung Galaxy Chromebook Go combines a compact, lightweight design with military-grade durability and a spill-resistant keyboard, helping it withstand the bumps and demands of everyday use while remaining practical for students and travelers. With up to 12 hours of battery life and fast-charging support, it provides dependable power for a full day of learning, work, and entertainment. The Intel Celeron N4500 processor and 4GB of memory deliver reliable performance for web browsing, online classes, document editing, video streaming, and other everyday tasks, while the combined 320GB storage solution—consisting of 64GB of built-in eMMC storage and an included 256GB SD card—provides convenient space for applications, schoolwork, photos, videos, and other files. Its 14-inch LED display features anti-glare technology for comfortable viewing, and the integrated 720p webcam supports online classes, video calls, and virtual meetings. The Chromebook can also expand your workspace across up to two compatible external monitors through USB-C, with support for resolutions up to 4K at 60Hz without requiring a docking station. Connectivity options include one USB 3.2 Type-A port, two USB Type-C ports, a headphone/microphone combo jack, and a microSD card reader, while Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth provide fast, stable wireless connections with compatible networks and accessories. Powered by ChromeOS with automatic updates available through June 2031, it offers fast startup, built-in security, and access to popular applications through Google Play, including Microsoft 365, Minecraft, Adobe Express, and more, making it well suited for K–12 and college students, online courses, Zoom meetings, document collaboration, and video streaming.
